recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate `BestieMart 2000: Supermarket Simulator`, a portrait-first browser canvas game where the player is a weekend cashier bestie scanning falling meme groceries on a receipt-like conveyor. Preserve the mechanics: items spawn above the playfield, fall downward, can be tapped once to earn money, missed items trigger feedback, a day timer advances to a shop screen, energy drains over time and can fail the run, shop purchases restore energy or increase scan payout, and buying the store wins.

The world should be vaporwave Y2K supermarket satire: pink/purple retro grid, BestieMart signage, sticker-like `REAL`, `TYCOON`, `BESTIE`, and `Y2K` props, decora grocery silhouettes (MILK.EXE bottle, Y2K cereal, star snack), and a kawaii scanner mascot named by visual behavior rather than exposition. Use mobile-readable HUD copy: Bestie Till, Cozy Shift Energy, Receipt Drop, Aisle Snackie, Sticker Scanner, Buy BestieMart. Keep one-thumb touch input and avoid blocking controls with decorative overlays.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Implemented source truth
The preserved source is a single-page canvas supermarket checkout game. It starts immediately, spawns falling items, lets the player tap an item to scan it, awards money per scan, drains energy over time, ends the day when a timer completes, opens a shop screen for purchases, and ends in failure when energy reaches zero or victory when the store is bought.

## Protected mechanics
- Pointer/touch tap on canvas scans one item per tap using the original generous circular hit test.
- Spawn probability, falling movement, day timer, energy drain, score gain, shop costs, salary multiplier, next-day progression, and win/fail states are preserved.
- Shop and restart buttons keep native click/tap paths; gameplay pointer handling remains scoped to play state.

## Transformable surfaces
- Canvas background, item drawings, focal mascot, HUD labels, copy, colors, particles, audio URLs, feedback captions, and shop wording.
- Scene identity can become an authored supermarket simulator environment without changing the conveyor loop.

## Remix blueprint
`BestieMart 2000: Supermarket Simulator` reframes the player as a weekend cashier bestie scanning meme groceries in a vaporwave Y2K supermarket. The focal actor is a kawaii scanner mascot. Rewards are decora grocery products; money becomes tycoon progress; energy is cozy shift stamina; the store purchase remains the success condition.
